! Title
| He Is Not Ready {{Errata hl|1=& Imperial Propaganda}} || He Is Not Ready
|-
! Game text
| Deploy on opponent's just deployed [Reflections 3][Maintenance] card; opponent loses 1 Force, and you may retrieve 1 Force and/or play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect. That [Maintenance] card is power -3, may not apply its ability towards drawing battle destiny, and, during opponent's draw phase, opponent must lose 1 Force or place that card in Lost Pile. If just lost, place this card in Used Pile. Immune to [[Honor Of The Jedi]]. (Immune to [[Control]].) OR If you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. || —
|}
